assumptions.electricity: External continuous electric grid. Report active demand and drain for rounded installed stations. Generation, storage and power distribution are not counted.
assumptions.resources: Iron ore, bauxite, sandstone, limestone patches and a fumarole at 100 percent yield. Mining machines are counted. No ore imports. No mining productivity bonus.
assumptions.construction: All process placement items are produced. Continuous fractional construction flow is not a startup schedule. Rutile and graphite seed stock is declared separately.
assumptions.comparison: Same post-pneumatic research entrance as the Vulcanus comparison. Comparable first/second-tier processing machines. All pre-physics recipes are eligible. No modules or beacons. Guaranteed outputs only.
assumptions.time: All science lines and labs are available at time zero. Research triggers are assumed satisfied. Times exclude construction, checkpoints and exploration.
assumptions.research_access: Exclude research requiring science that cannot be produced locally, and all dependent research. No imported planetary science.
assumptions.waste: No solid discard; all surplus requires a real local processing or fluid disposal recipe.
assumptions.comparison_outputs: Six common science packs at the stated rate, plus local metallurgic or electromagnetic science at that rate where available.
